preserved_historical_overrides.reason: Pre-existing app/canonical display difference; unrelated to this adoption and preserved exactly.

edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. No intermediate profile or new old-spelling aliases.

rationale.sozi: User adopts 肖ˢ to emphasize resemblance, share 肖 with portret, and reduce 19 to 7 strokes. Preserve the meaning of an unrelated lookalike in annotations.
rationale.fobi: User adopts 怕ᶠ to state fear/phobia rather than generic symptom. Preserve clinical and compound meanings in annotations and the existing fob/fobi decomposition.
rationale.propagation: Existing identifier generator changes fob to 怕ᶠᴼ, simptom to 症 and six established mirror-root bodies. No algorithm or root decomposition changes.

migration_notice: Current ownership of 怕ᶠ moves from fob to fobi; 症 moves from fobi to simptom; the corresponding full hidrofob/ksenofob keys move to the i-final roots. Fixed legacy retains all original owners; no aliases or intermediate edition are added.
